Summary: Zoom crashes frequently, especially after a recent update. The most recent crash occurred right after a new version of Zoom Workplace was installed.
likely_cause: A recent update to Zoom Workplace version 6.4.1 may have caused instability, leading to crashes.
Evidence: Zoom crashed at 2:35:49 AM on Saturday, the same day a new version (6.4.1) was installed.
Previous crashes occurred on Friday, within a short time of the update.
No resource usage data available to show high CPU or memory use during crashes.
Only one change recorded: installation of Zoom Workplace 6.4.1 on Thursday.
Steps: Uninstall Zoom Workplace and restart your computer.
Download and install the latest stable version of Zoom from the official website.
Check if crashes stop after the update.
Reinstall Zoom if it still crashes, and avoid using it during updates.
